content.intro: Coolant loss on the BMW X3 G01 M40i is a common concern. Recurring top-ups warrant investigation of the water pump and related components.

blocks.text: Drivers notice low coolant warnings and may eventually need to inspect BMW X3 M40i water pump failure as a common root cause on the B58 engine.
Refer to the X3 M40i cooling system guide for the full component overview before replacing parts.
